title: Pin gVisor runner metadata schema
summary: Runtime execution hardening needs a pinned, inspectable record of the Linux gVisor runner inputs (runsc version, rootfs digest/source, and host prerequisites) before CI promotion. Define a small schema and validation hook so future CI enablement is auditable and repeatable.
expectedFailureModes: CI promotion proceeds without a pinned runsc/rootfs record, making failures non-reproducible.
Docs claim the runner is pinned but the output schema is missing or inconsistent across hosts.
Validator allows machine-local paths or unpinned binaries, undermining auditability.
nextAction: Extend gvisor host readiness outputs/docs with pinned runner metadata fields and add a validator that enforces the schema when CI promotion work begins.
